description: React component for displaying and managing a skill distribution ring with add, modify, and delete functionalities, including fetching and updating user learning profile data.

methods.name: handleMouseMove
methods.description: Updates tooltip position based on mouse movement over the skill ring.

methods.name: handleAddSkill
methods.description: Handles adding a new skill to the user's profile, updating state and profile data.

methods.name: handleModifySkill
methods.description: Handles modifying an existing skill's proficiency in the user's profile.

methods.name: handleRemoveSkill
methods.description: Handles removing a skill from the user's profile.
